name: Snow Leopard Cub
description: A cute, detailed snow leopard cub sitting with one paw raised: oversized round head, full white cheeks and whisker pads, huge glossy eyes with catch-lights, low rounded ears, rosettes and forehead speckles, a thick ringed tail and black toe beans. Fur painted in brush strokes at 4 texels/unit.
author: lowpix example
